title: The Keepers of the Secret Harvest
intro: In a verdant land, a group of individuals made a secret plan under the cover of darkness. They shared a common purpose, but their intention was far from righteous. Little did they know that a divine twist awaited them as they slept.
clues: We made a firm resolve, thinking our plan was flawless.
We intended to go out early, before others could even stir.
We set upon a fertile plot, confident in our provisions.
As we reached our destination, we found it barren and desolate, so we thought we had lost our way.
Then we realized it was indeed our place, and we cried out in despair, blaming each other for our loss.
We had sworn that morning to exclude the poor from our harvest, but Allah's punishment came upon us while we slept, turning our garden into ruin.

identity.label: Who Are We?
options: The Owners of the Garden in Surah 68
The People of Saba
The Companions of the Cave
The People of the Elephant
The People of the Trench
identity.answer: The Owners of the Garden in Surah 68

trial.label: Our Trial
options: Our garden was destroyed by a calamity from the sky
Our garden was swept by a flood
Our garden was burned by a fire from an enemy
Our garden was filled with locusts
Our garden was swallowed by an earthquake
trial.answer: Our garden was destroyed by a calamity from the sky

location.label: Key Element
options: We swore to pluck its fruits in the morning
We built a dam to irrigate our garden
We sought refuge in a cave for protection
We prepared an army to conquer a kingdom
We sailed a ship to cross the sea
location.answer: We swore to pluck its fruits in the morning

outcome.label: Our Fate
options: We repented and hoped for mercy from Allah
We were completely destroyed and never repented
We fled the land and never returned
We became powerful and wealthy again
We were punished by being turned into monkeys
outcome.answer: We repented and hoped for mercy from Allah

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
